g0.rationale: 2in1 Kur & Spülung. Kur mode: washed wet hair, 2–3 minutes, rinse → qualifies. Spülung mode is the conditioner mode (marketed as Spülung, 'kurz … ca. 30 Sekunden') and is not a mask mode — the standard's R1 worked case for this exact product. Classified on the Kur mode only.

tailMarker.note: Earliest tail-class species is the chelator @7 (R8 class); Ethylhexylglycerin @9 is paired with Phenoxyethanol @12; Parfum @13. Base species (Cetearyl @2, Behentrimonium Chloride @3, Cetyl Esters @5) outrank it. Plausible. tail_index−1 = Panthenol @6.

conditioningLevel.rationale: S1: Behentrimonium Chloride @3 only → fails. S2: Cetearyl Alcohol @2. S3: Cetyl Esters @5 only (Avena Sativa Kernel Oil @11 in tail) → fails. One signal → moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: Positive leanness test: no R4b above the marker (Cetyl Esters @5 is a wax ester; Avena Sativa Kernel Oil @11 is in the tail), no silicone, exactly one cationic on the full list (Behentrimonium Chloride @3). Plausible marker, no boundary dependence → low.

careDirection.rationale: No R5 species (Glycine @10 is a free amino acid). Humectants above tail: Dipropylene Glycol @4, Panthenol @6 (partial). Coherent conditioning/humectant base → moisture.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: No R5 route, no bond token; panthenol and glycine are explicit non-upgraders.

primaryFocus.rationale: Step 3 clears nothing. Moisture guard criterion 1 fails (2 humectants above tail, no glycerin). No silicone/polymer for shine or smoothing. → general. focus_care_verdict: nonspecific.

fired.note: Profile describes only the Kur mode; the Spülung mode is Conditioner-engine territory and is not profiled here.
Repair positioning carried by Panthenol/Glycine only, which are non-qualifiers; moves no value.
